1. The above Statement of Unaudited Financial Results of 3MIndia Limited ("the Company”) which includes Statement of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months period ended 30 September 2026, including the Unaudited Statement of Assets and Liabilities as at 30 September 2026 and the Unaudited Statement of Cash Flows for the six months period ended 30 September 2026, together with notes thereon (“Statement of Unaudited Financial Results") have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and thereafter approved by the Board of Directors and taken on record at their respective meetings held on 06 November 2026.
2. The above Statement of Unaudited Financial Results have been reviewed by the Statutory Auditors and they have issued an unmodified review opinion on the same. The review report of the Statutory Auditors is being filed with National Stock Exchange of India Limited ("NSE") and BSE Limited (''BSE”) and is also available on the Company's website at https://www.3mindia.in/3M/en IN/company-in/about-3m/financial-facts-local/.
3. The above Statement of Unaudited Financial Results has been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid downin Indian AccountingStandard 34 " nterim Financial Reporting” (“Ind AS 34”) under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013, and other accounting principles generally accepted in India, read with the relevant rules issued thereunder and in terms of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended ("ListingRegulations, 2015”).
4. The Company has no subsidiary/ associate/ joint venture company(ies) for all the periods presented above.
5. Exceptional item for the 3 months period ended 30 June 2026 and six months period ended 30 September 2026 represent gain (net of cost of asset and related expenses) on sale of land located at Pimpri, Pune, pursuant to a conveyance deedexecuted on29 June 2026 for a totalconsideration of Rs. 82.00 crores.
6. During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, pursuant to theapproval of the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting held on 26 August 2026, the Company paid a dividend of Rs. 506 per equity share of face value Rs. 10 each, comprising of final dividend of Rs. 160 per equity share and a special dividend of Rs. 346 per equity share, for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.
7. The Company's annual financial statements for the year ended 31 March 2026, were presented in Rs. crores Accordingly, the comparative figures for the corresponding 3 months period ended and 6 months period ended 30 September 2025, which were presented in Rs. lakhs, have been rounded off to Rs. crores for comparative purposes. The change in presentation has no impact on the unaudited financial results (including segment disclosure) or financial position or cash flows of the Company.
8. Subsequent to 30 September 2026, the Board of Directors of the Company, on 26 October 2026, approved the key commercial terms for proposed amendments to certain agreements relating to the Company's health care business. Under the proposed amendments, subject to satisfaction of the agreed conditions, certain rights and obligations relating to specified products will be terminated, for which the Company will receive a one-time compensation of US$13 million from Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. and/or its nominated affiliate. The same has been considered as a non-adjusting event after the reporting period. Accordingly, no adjustment has been made to the unaudited financial results for the 3 months period ended and 6 months period ended 30 September 2026.
9. Refer subsequent pagefordisclosure of unaudited segment wiserevenue, results, assetsand liabilities for the quarter and six monthsperiodended 30 September 2026.
